messages:
maria: seeing spike in GPU pending in eu-west1 this morning, dozens of tiny jobs stuck :confused:
kevin: noticed, fast-provision pool dropped 120 -> 75 around 06:10 UTC
ashley: any clue in provisioner logs?
maria: reconciler shows a stream of `heartbeat_mismatch` and `lease_ttl_expired` starting 06:12, provision requests return success but slots are never Ready
kevin: hmm we rolled fleet-agent yesterday; could be mixed-version incompat between 2.4.x and 2.5.0
sre-bot: ALERT: provisioner_rate > 0.2 and pending_gpu > 50 in eu-west1
leo: log snippet: ```
2026-03-23T06:12:03Z reconciler: slot=eu-west1-az1-12 event=lease_refresh err=heartbeat_mismatch expected=162345 got=0
2026-03-23T06:12:04Z slot-manager: mark_ready failed slot=eu-west1-az1-12 reason=ttl_expired
```
maria: looks like heartbeat schema added `heartbeat_epoch` in 2.5.0; older fleet-agent interprets missing field as error
kevin: did the canary include all zones?
leo: only eu-west1 was partially on 2.5.0 during the deploy, so versions mixed across the region
ashley: short-term mitigation: increase lease TTL and run reconciler sweep; long-term: add parser fallback for missing epoch
maria: applied TTL bump: `kubectl patch cm gpu-provisioner-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"lease_ttl":"90s"}}'` (was 30s)
sre-bot: Autoscaler: pool target bumped +20 after TTL change, actual ready slots still lagging
leo: ran manual sweep `./tools/sweep-ready.sh --region eu-west1 --force`, reclaimed ~26 slots, pending dropped ~22
maria: still ~15 pods stuck at AttachVolume NVLINK attach timeout, likely separate but amplifies impact
ashley: PR for parser fallback opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/412
kevin: rollback plan?
leo: canary 10% eu-west1a -> 30% region, monitor `lease_error_rate`, autopromote disabled, revert helm if error_rate > 0.05
maria: cost note: scaled +20 for 3h, cost spike acceptable vs customer timeouts (finance acked)
ashley: postmortem items: add heartbeat_schema_mismatch_total metric, migration tests, alert with sweep runbook
leo: also saw egress retry bump same window, tracking in infra channel separately
maria: starting 2.5.1 canary now, monitoring dashboards; will update with status or rollback
kevin: thanks, if customer traffic impacted tag @sre-oncall and escalate
ashley: ack
leo: final summary will go to #incidents once stable
